verdict.rationale: Runloop is API/SDK-driven, so it runs headlessly by design. The `rli` CLI offers traditional non-interactive commands alongside its TUI, benchmark jobs can be submitted from the CLI, commands can be executed and their logs retrieved via the API, and an official deploy-agent GitHub Action automates deployment from CI workflows. missing for 10: CI integration documented beyond the agent-deployment GitHub Action (e.g. running devboxes or benchmarks from CI pipelines), explicit documentation of non-interactive CI authentication, independent or hands-on corroboration.
